'''''Legacy of the Force: Betrayal''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[May 30]], [[2006]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[May 1]], [[2007]] and includes the short stories "[[In His Image]]" and "[[A Two-Edged Sword]]" by [[Karen Traviss]].
